t: Entitled, "Approving and adopting the official map of C. S. Allred's subdivisions of blocks 17 and 18…
Accepting Deeds to O. S. All red for Opening of Wanda Street.
Second Series), approve a map of C. S. Alired's subdivision of blocks 17 and 18, West End Map No. 1, which map was filed in the office of the Board of Supervisors…

Entitled, "Approving and accepting a deed to lands from C. S. Allred to the City and County of San Francisco for the opening of Wanda street, and declaring that portion covered by said deed to be an open, public street." Adopted.
Accepting Deeds to Q. a. All red for Opening of Wanda Street.
